assumptions: Authorization is issue 2467 (repo-maintenance route) dispatched by the Claude repo-maintenance session; no migration lane and no db claim.
The supported option set is exactly the options runGovernedReview reads: issue, pr, head-sha, reviewer, wrapper, worktree, review-slot, replacement-sequence, assignment-id, skip-doctor.
goal: Make run-governed-review.mjs refuse unknown arguments such as --slot instead of silently defaulting to review slot 1.
prohibited_actions: No database, migration, preview, production, claim or marker mutation.
No workflow, repository setting or branch protection change.
stop_conditions: Stop if a documented caller passes an option outside the supported set.
